chunks: Muhammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from al-ʿAbbās, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
“Do not make up the witr of your night, if you missed it, until you perform the zawāl prayer on the day of the two ʿĪds.”

key_terms.الزَّوَالَ: the prayer at or after midday decline
key_terms.لَيْلَتِكَ: your night; referring to the previous night's devotional prayer time
key_terms.وِتْرَ: the witr prayer of the night
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْعِيدَيْنِ: the day of the two ʿĪds, ʿĪd al-Fiṭr and ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā

ai.seo_question: If I missed the witr prayer, should I make it up before or after the zawāl prayer on the day of ʿĪd?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the order of devotional prayers on the day of the two ʿĪds. It instructs that if the night witr prayer was missed, it should not be made up before performing the prayer associated with zawāl on that day.
